question: In the original Transformer architecture, where do all of the keys, values, and queries come from in an encoder self-attention layer, and in almost all cases prior to the Transformer, what were attention mechanisms used in conjunction with?
gold_answer: In the original Transformer architecture, all of the keys, values, and queries in an encoder self-attention layer come from the output of the previous layer in the encoder. In an encoder self-attention layer, all of the keys, values, and queries come from the same place, in this case, the output of the previous layer in the encoder [1]. Each position in the encoder can attend to all positions in the previous layer of the encoder.

question: According to the IPCC AR6 Synthesis Report, what are the specific geographic regions along with the Arctic, LDCs, and Small Islands where the largest impacts of extreme weather on food and water security have been observed, and what measure can water-intensive industries like mining undertake to reduce water stress?
gold_answer: The largest impacts have been observed in Africa, Asia, Central and South America, and water-intensive industries can undertake measures such as water recycling and reuse, using brackish or saline sources, and improving water use efficiency.

The largest impacts of extreme weather on food and water security have been observed in Africa, Asia, Central and South America, LDCs, Small Islands, and the Arctic [1].
